units.source_text: 源氏公子在这邸内静息一会之后，就写信给京中诸人。

en.t: After resting quietly for a while in this residence, Prince Genji wrote letters to people in the capital.

units.source_text: 紫姬派来的使者，途中受尽了狂风暴雨的威胁，到此又逢雷雨袭击，满怀忧虑，吞声饮泣地留在须磨。

en.t: The messenger sent by Lady Murasaki had suffered the threats of violent wind and rain on the road, and after arriving here was struck by another thunderstorm; full of anxiety, he stayed in Suma, choking back his sobs.

units.source_text: 源氏公子召唤他来此，赏赐他额外丰富的物品，遣他回京。

en.t: Prince Genji summoned him there, gave him especially generous gifts, and sent him back to the capital.

units.source_text: 托他带信去，把近来种种情状详细告知亲信的祈祷师及一切知己。

en.t: He entrusted letters to him, asking him to tell his trusted prayer master and all his close acquaintances in detail about his recent circumstances.

units.source_text: 对师姑藤壶皇后，又叙述最近因梦而免于危难的奇迹。

en.t: To Empress Fujitsubo, his aunt by religion, he also described the miracle by which a dream had recently saved him from danger.

units.source_text: 对紫姬那封哀怨的来书的回信，他不能顺利地写下去，写了数行，便放笔拭泪。

en.t: As for his reply to Lady Murasaki's sorrowful and reproachful letter, he could not write it smoothly; after a few lines, he set down his brush and wiped away his tears.

units.source_text: 看了这模样，可知毕竟与对他人不同。

en.t: Seeing him like this, one could tell that, after all, she was different from everyone else to him.

units.source_text: 信中有云：“我身历尽种种艰辛，常思舍此浊世，出家为僧。

en.t: In the letter he wrote: "Having endured every kind of hardship, I have often thought of leaving this impure world and becoming a monk.

units.source_text: 但因你临别吟咏‘对此菱花即慰心’时的面影，常常闪现在我眼前，永无消失之时，则我又安能决然舍去？

en.t: But because the image of you at parting, reciting 'Facing these water-chestnut flowers comforts my heart,' keeps appearing before my eyes and never fades, how could I resolutely abandon everything?

units.source_text: 每念及此，便觉此间种种苦痛，都不足道了。

en.t: Whenever I think of this, all the many sufferings here seem hardly worth mentioning.
Indeed, it is just as the poem says:
